assumptions: The historical BSKSim-style name identifies project equations and does not establish official native electrical power authority.
Configured payload, transmitter, idle and bus loads plus compact solar/battery equations form a local mission resource model.
Local equation-model counts are not native electrical provider-instance counts and do not establish native runtime closure.

comm_profiles.native_downlink: official AntennaPower plus separate base and idle SimplePowerSink nodes
comm_profiles.fallback_transmitter: official fixed active 32 W, PDU-enabled idle 2 W and off 0 W sinks selected by native transmitter status

assumptions: Fixed device profiles and heat deposition fractions are engineering parameters, not calibrated flight power models.
Reduced heaters use their actual thermostat/forced/PDU/scaled output with unity electrical-to-heat efficiency; unconfigured heaters are absent.
Thermal deposition and status-only adapters are separate from electrical power authority; explicitly disabled coupling edges do not claim resource closure.
Propellant depletion and thrust mechanics do not constitute an electrical load or a valve/controller power model.
Prescribed internal and heater watts are thermal boundary inputs; this route does not close them against a battery or electrical bus.
The default route computes solar generation, configured device/heater loads, battery energy and lumped heat with local equations.
Optional source-provider variants remain within their declared module scope; this capability does not provide the native whole-runtime power-authority census.

assumptions: Fixed payload and propulsion auxiliary electrical profiles and thermal deposition fractions remain configured engineering assumptions.
Propulsion auxiliary loads represent valve/controller electricity, not chemical or mechanical thrust power.
Project heater electrical outputs are physical subsystem authorities; status adapters and heat conversion do not own additional electrical loads.
